links.outcome: Test-retest consistency of deep learning brain segmentation volumes across scanner types and field strengths
links.effect: High consistency on the same scanner type (1.5 T to 1.5 T or 3 T to 3 T), slightly better at 1.5 T than 3 T. Cross-scanner (1.5 T vs 3 T) consistency was slightly lower. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: However, cross-comparisons between different scanner types (1.5 T vs. 3 T) demonstrated slightly less consistency, highlighting the influence of magnetic field strength on segmentation accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Using the same scanner type and imaging protocol for longitudinal AI-based volumetric monitoring

screen.reason: Evaluates the reproducibility and technical repeatability of deep learning-based MRI brain segmentation across different scanner field strengths (1.5T vs 3T) with human-in-the-loop workflow, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
